package @PACKAGE@;

import com.codename1.backend.image.JpegCodec;
import com.codename1.backend.image.PngCodec;
import com.codename1.backend.image.RasterGraphics;
import com.codename1.backend.image.RasterImage;
import com.codename1.backend.image.RasterPath;
import com.codename1.backend.image.Resampler;
import com.codename1.backend.image.TrueTypeFont;
import com.codename1.python.runtime.Py;
import com.codename1.python.runtime.PyImage;
import com.codename1.python.runtime.PyImageData;
import com.codename1.python.runtime.PyImageEngine;
import java.io.IOException;

/// PIL's server engine over the backend's `com.codename1.backend.image`:
/// Pillow's resampling byte for byte, PNG and JPEG, and TrueType text laid
/// out as FreeType lays it out. Generated only into a backend build, so a
/// client build never references the backend's classes.
final class BackendImage implements PyImageEngine {
    private BackendImage() {
    }

    static void install() {
        PyImage.setEngine(new BackendImage());
    }

    private static RuntimeException osError(IOException e) {
        return Py.error(Py.OS_ERROR, String.valueOf(e.getMessage()));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean exact() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean available() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public PyImageData decode(byte[] data) {
        throw Py.error(Py.OS_ERROR, "only PNG and JPEG are decoded on a server");
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] encode(PyImageData rgba, String format, float quality) {
        throw Py.error(Py.OS_ERROR, "only PNG and JPEG are encoded on a server, not " + format);
    }

    private static PyImageData of(int w, int h, int bands, byte[] d) {
        PyImageData r = new PyImageData(w, h, bands);
        System.arraycopy(d, 0, r.d, 0, r.d.length);
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public PyImageData resample(PyImageData s, int w, int h, double[] box, int filter, boolean premultiplied) {
        byte[] src = premultiplied ? Resampler.premultiply(s.d, s.bands) : s.d;
        byte[] d = Resampler.resample(src, s.w, s.h, s.bands, w, h, box, filter);
        if (premultiplied) {
            d = Resampler.unpremultiply(d, s.bands);
        }
        return of(w, h, s.bands, d);
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] pngUnfilter(byte[] data, int row, int h, int bpp) {
        try {
            return PngCodec.unfilter(data, 0, row, h, bpp);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw osError(e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public PyImageData pngExpand(byte[] raw, int w, int h, int ctype, int depth) {
        int bands = ctype == 0 || ctype == 3 ? 1 : ctype == 2 ? 3 : ctype == 4 ? 2 : 4;
        return of(w, h, bands, PngCodec.expand(raw, w, h, ctype, depth));
    }

    @Override
    public PyImageData jpegDecode(byte[] data) {
        RasterImage ri;
        try {
            ri = JpegCodec.decode(data);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw osError(e);
        }
        int bands = JpegCodec.componentCount(data) == 1 ? 1 : 3;
        int[] px = ri.getPixels();
        PyImageData r = new PyImageData(ri.getWidth(), ri.getHeight(), bands);
        for (int p = 0; p < px.length; p++) {
            int c = px[p];
            if (bands == 1) {
                r.d[p] = (byte) c;
            } else {
                r.d[p * 3] = (byte) (c >> 16);
                r.d[p * 3 + 1] = (byte) (c >> 8);
                r.d[p * 3 + 2] = (byte) c;
            }
        }
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] jpegEncode(PyImageData s, float quality) {
        if (s.bands != 1 && s.bands != 3) {
            throw Py.error(Py.OS_ERROR, "cannot write this mode as JPEG");
        }
        int[] px = new int[s.w * s.h];
        for (int p = 0; p < px.length; p++) {
            int r = s.d[p * s.bands] & 0xff;
            int g = s.bands == 1 ? r : s.d[p * 3 + 1] & 0xff;
            int b = s.bands == 1 ? r : s.d[p * 3 + 2] & 0xff;
            px[p] = 0xff000000 | r << 16 | g << 8 | b;
        }
        return JpegCodec.encode(new RasterImage(s.w, s.h, px), quality, s.bands == 1);
    }

    private static FreeTypeMetrics ft(Object f) {
        if (f instanceof FreeTypeMetrics) {
            return (FreeTypeMetrics) f;
        }
        throw Py.typeError("not a TrueType font");
    }

    @Override
    public Object loadFont(byte[] data, int index, double size) {
        try {
            return new FreeTypeMetrics(TrueTypeFont.load(data, index, size));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw osError(e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] defaultFontData() {
        return TrueTypeFont.getDefaultFontData();
    }

    @Override
    public Object defaultFont(double size) {
        return new FreeTypeMetrics(TrueTypeFont.createDefault(size));
    }

    @Override
    public Object deriveFont(Object font, double size) {
        return new FreeTypeMetrics(ft(font).font.deriveFont(size));
    }

    @Override
    public String[] fontName(Object font) {
        TrueTypeFont f = ft(font).font;
        return new String[] {f.getFamilyName(), f.getStyleName()};
    }

    @Override
    public int[] fontMetrics(Object font) {
        FreeTypeMetrics f = ft(font);
        return new int[] {FreeTypeMetrics.pixel(f.ascender), -FreeTypeMetrics.pixel(f.descender)};
    }

    @Override
    public long textLength(Object font, String text) {
        return ft(font).length(text);
    }

    @Override
    public int[] textBox(Object font, String text, String anchor) {
        FreeTypeMetrics f = ft(font);
        return f.box(f.layout(text), anchor);
    }

    @Override
    public PyImageData textMask(Object font, String text, String anchor, boolean mono) {
        FreeTypeMetrics f = ft(font);
        FreeTypeMetrics.Layout l = f.layout(text);
        int[] b = f.box(l, anchor);
        PyImageData r = new PyImageData(Math.max(0, b[0]), Math.max(0, b[1]), 1);
        byte[] cov = f.mask(l, b, mono);
        System.arraycopy(cov, 0, r.d, 0, Math.min(cov.length, r.d.length));
        return r;
    }
}

/// Pillow's basic text layout over a `TrueTypeFont`, in FreeType's 26.6
/// fixed point, so `getlength`, `getbbox`, `getmetrics` and the anchors give
/// the integers Pillow gives.
///
/// Pillow loads glyphs with `FT_LOAD_DEFAULT`, so FreeType rounds every
/// advance to a whole pixel, the ascender up and the descender down. Glyph
/// boxes come from the control box of the scaled outline, floored and ceiled
/// to pixels (`FT_GLYPH_BBOX_PIXELS`). Outlines are not hinted here; a font
/// with TrueType instructions can therefore differ from FreeType by a pixel
/// at the edge of a box, never in an advance.
///
/// Kerning follows Pillow's `text_layout_fallback`, which adds the pixel
/// count of a `kern` pair to an advance kept in 64ths of a pixel -- a pair
/// moves the pen by a 64th per pixel of kerning. That is what Pillow does,
/// so it is what this does.
final class FreeTypeMetrics {
    final TrueTypeFont font;
    private final long scale;
    final long ascender;
    final long descender;

    FreeTypeMetrics(TrueTypeFont font) {
        this.font = font;
        long size26 = (long) (font.getSize() * 64);
        int upem = font.getUnitsPerEm();
        this.scale = ((size26 << 16) + upem / 2) / upem;
        this.ascender = ceil(mulFix(font.getAscenderUnits(), scale));
        this.descender = floor(mulFix(font.getDescenderUnits(), scale));
    }

    static long mulFix(long a, long b) {
        long p = a * b;
        return p >= 0 ? (p + 0x8000) >> 16 : -((-p + 0x8000) >> 16);
    }

    static long floor(long v) {
        return v & -64;
    }

    static long ceil(long v) {
        return (v + 63) & -64;
    }

    static long round(long v) {
        return (v + 32) & -64;
    }

    /// Pillow's `PIXEL`: a 26.6 value rounded to whole pixels.
    static int pixel(long v) {
        return (int) (((v + 32) & -64) >> 6);
    }

    /// Text layout: glyph indices and advances in 26.6.
    static final class Layout {
        final int[] glyphs;
        final long[] advances;
        int count;
        long position;

        Layout(int capacity) {
            glyphs = new int[capacity];
            advances = new long[capacity];
        }
    }

    /// Returns whether `anchor` is one of Pillow's horizontal anchors (null
    /// meaning the default, `la`).
    static boolean validAnchor(String anchor) {
        return anchor == null || (anchor.length() == 2 && "lmr".indexOf(anchor.charAt(0)) >= 0
                && "atmsbd".indexOf(anchor.charAt(1)) >= 0);
    }

    Layout layout(String text) {
        int n = text.length();
        Layout l = new Layout(n);
        int last = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int cp = text.charAt(i++);
            if (cp >= 0xd800 && cp < 0xdc00 && i < n) {
                int lo = text.charAt(i);
                if (lo >= 0xdc00 && lo < 0xe000) {
                    cp = ((cp - 0xd800) << 10) + (lo - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
                    i++;
                }
            }
            int g = font.glyphIndex(cp);
            int k = l.count;
            if (last != 0 && g != 0) {
                long delta = round(mulFix(font.kerning(last, g), scale));
                // Whole pixels added to a 26.6 advance on purpose: Pillow's
                // own x_advance += PIXEL(delta.x), so text lays out the same.
                l.advances[k - 1] += pixel(delta);
            }
            l.glyphs[k] = g;
            l.advances[k] = round(mulFix(font.glyphAdvance(g), scale));
            l.count++;
            last = g;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < l.count; k++) {
            l.position += l.advances[k];
        }
        return l;
    }

    long length(String text) {
        return layout(text).position;
    }

    /// Returns `{width, height, xOffset, yOffset, xMin, yMax}` as Pillow's
    /// `bounding_box_and_anchors` computes them for horizontal text; the
    /// anchor must pass [#validAnchor(String)].
    int[] box(Layout l, String anchor) {
        long position = 0;
        int xMin = 0;
        int xMax = 0;
        int yMin = 0;
        int yMax = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < l.count; i++) {
            int px = pixel(position);
            position += l.advances[i];
            int advanced = pixel(position);
            if (advanced > xMax) {
                xMax = advanced;
            }
            double[] b = font.glyphBounds(l.glyphs[i]);
            if (b == null) {
                continue;
            }
            int bx0 = (int) (floor(scaled(b[0])) >> 6) + px;
            int by0 = (int) (floor(scaled(b[1])) >> 6);
            int bx1 = (int) (ceil(scaled(b[2])) >> 6) + px;
            int by1 = (int) (ceil(scaled(b[3])) >> 6);
            xMax = Math.max(xMax, bx1);
            xMin = Math.min(xMin, bx0);
            yMax = Math.max(yMax, by1);
            yMin = Math.min(yMin, by0);
        }
        String a = anchor == null ? "la" : anchor;
        int xAnchor;
        int yAnchor;
        switch (a.charAt(0)) {
            case 'l':
                xAnchor = 0;
                break;
            case 'm':
                xAnchor = l.count == 0 ? 0 : pixel(l.position / 2);
                break;
            default:
                xAnchor = l.count == 0 ? 0 : pixel(l.position);
                break;
        }
        switch (a.charAt(1)) {
            case 'a':
                yAnchor = pixel(ascender);
                break;
            case 't':
                yAnchor = yMax;
                break;
            case 'm':
                yAnchor = pixel((ascender + descender) / 2);
                break;
            case 's':
                yAnchor = 0;
                break;
            case 'b':
                yAnchor = yMin;
                break;
            default:
                yAnchor = pixel(descender);
                break;
        }
        if (l.count == 0) {
            xAnchor = 0;
            yAnchor = 0;
        }
        return new int[] {xMax - xMin, yMax - yMin, xMin - xAnchor, yAnchor - yMax, xMin, yMax};
    }

    private long scaled(double units) {
        return mulFix(Math.round(units), scale);
    }

    /// Renders the layout as an 8-bit coverage mask of `box`'s size, the
    /// glyph origins at Pillow's pixel pen positions.
    byte[] mask(Layout l, int[] box, boolean mono) {
        int w = box[0];
        int h = box[1];
        byte[] out = new byte[w * h];
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
            return out;
        }
        RasterImage img = new RasterImage(w, h);
        RasterGraphics g = img.createGraphics();
        g.setAntiAlias(!mono);
        g.setColor(0xffffffff);
        RasterPath path = new RasterPath();
        // the mask's left edge is xMin, its top edge yMax above the baseline
        long position = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < l.count; i++) {
            int px = pixel(position);
            position += l.advances[i];
            font.appendGlyph(path, l.glyphs[i], px - box[4], box[5]);
        }
        g.fill(path);
        int[] px = img.getPixels();
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            int a = px[i] >>> 24;
            out[i] = (byte) (mono ? (a >= 128 ? 255 : 0) : a);
        }
        return out;
    }
}
